statement: In the conversation reducer, a cut boundary index is legal only if the message at that index has role user, assistant, assistant_progress, or assistant_tool_call; a tool_result role cannot be a legal start even when its pairing is malformed. A cut is illegal when any removed tool call ID appears among retained tool results. Pick the first legal index AT OR AFTER the proposed index, never move toward older messages; if none exists return len(messages), meaning summarize the complete span.

evidence.quote: Legal cut roles are user, assistant, assistant_progress, assistant_tool_call. A cut is illegal when any removed tool call ID appears among retained tool results. Pick the first legal index AT OR AFTER the proposed index, never move toward older messages. If none exists return len(messages), meaning summarize the complete span. Do not treat a result as a legal start, even when its pairing is malformed.

statement: In the conversation reducer, messages before the cut boundary are summarized and messages from the cut onward remain. Internal call messages use role='assistant_tool_call' and carry a toolUseId; their corresponding results use role='tool_result' with the same toolUseId.

evidence.quote: Conversation reducer design: messages before cut are summarized, messages from cut onward remain. Internal call messages have role='assistant_tool_call' and toolUseId; results have role='tool_result' with the same toolUseId.
